description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes annual historical files from the EIA-767 Steam-Electric Plant Operation and Design Report for 1985–2005. The provider describes organic-fuelled and combustible-renewable steam plants with generator nameplate ratings of at least 10 MW. Equipment descriptions cover boilers, generators, cooling systems, flue-gas treatment equipment and stacks. Nuclear plant data ceased to be collected in 2001. The survey ended in 2005, with no 2006 collection; EIA-860 and EIA-923 collected most successor fields from 2007. Each annual ZIP is described as containing fourteen XLS spreadsheets, including a user guide. The historical equipment and operating variables can support reconstruction of power-plant configurations and cooling dependencies. Historical survey coverage and successor definitions require checking before combining years. Access is free through the public download directory. EIA states that its government publications are public domain and requests acknowledgement. Caveats: only landing-page metadata was inspected; no spreadsheets or archives were downloaded, and field completeness and units remain unverified. Related resources are the EIA survey catalogues.
